title: Data On Foreigners Working Without Valid Employment Passes
what_it_is: Data On Foreigners Working Without Valid Employment Passes

sections.label: Foreigner illegal employment outcomes
sections.summary: On average 13 foreigners were prosecuted, four fined, the rest warned, and all repatriated and debarred from working in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On average, 13 foreigners were prosecuted, four were fined and the rest were issued with warnings, as most of the cases involved short duration of illegal employment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These foreigners were also repatriated and debarred from working in Singapore.

sections.label: Wedding shoot cases
sections.summary: About two wedding shoot cases per year occurred over the last two years, from about 2021 to about 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: Specific to wedding shoots, we get on average about two cases per year over the last two years, if I take the timeline from about 2021 to about 2023.

sections.label: Foreign manpower enforcement measures
sections.summary: Services and construction sectors are mainly involved, with fines, jail, proactive and reactive inspections, and warnings for most perpetrators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: To the second question on the services and sectors that are involved, essentially, we see it mainly in the services and construction sector, which usually has a slightly higher number than the rest; and for this, a whole range of legislation has been put in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: For example, errant workers under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act would be fined up to $20,000 or jailed up to two years or both; and for employers this amount is $30,000 and an imprisonment term of about 12 months or both.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: But beyond legislation, there are two regimes of inspections: proactive inspections – primarily dealing with areas at which we think are more highly prevalent – and reactive inspections that results from either whistle-blower cases, as exactly as the Member has pointed out, or through the MOM channels, either through our websites or call centres and services centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: To the third question, it is indeed a very important one, because there are many who may be unfortunately misled and it is not going to be very helpful for us to use very heavy mechanisms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dinesh Vasu Dash
sentences.text: And and that is why, in my reply, you will realise that the bulk of the perpetrators in this case, depending on the severity of their of their offence, was indeed warned.
